label: inp-manual
method: manual: Chrome DevTools Performance panel, worst interaction per page load; cross-checked with a PerformanceObserver on 'event' entries
throttling: CPU 4x slowdown, network Slow 4G — matches the Lighthouse mobile preset
interaction: typing "biedronka" into the transaction search field at a normal pace, after the page had settled

steps.source: perf/runs/baseline-inp.json, which also has the per-phase breakdown

steps.note: Start of the INP work. 1352 -> 1014 is not attributed to any fix: none of the LCP, CLS or bundle changes targeted interaction cost, and this was a different day's session.
useMemo on filter + sort, measured on its own. No separate commit: it landed together with useDeferredValue in 554f2b5. Samples overlap with the previous step, i.e. no measurable change.

useDeferredValue before virtualization: a 7x regression, samples do not overlap. Each keystroke starts a low-priority render of up to 8000 rows, the next keystroke restarts it, and the starved work is eventually flushed synchronously - 4.79 s of processing inside one interaction.

notes: Until this file existed, every number after the baseline lived only in commit messages.
inpMs is the worst of the three page loads per step, the same rule as baseline-inp.json.
